observed: User reported that the various LISTEN scope controls did not seem to do much on phone.
0.2.2 made scope operational, but the app recomputed scopeWindow from audio.currentTime on every pointermove.
Because pointermove also changed audio.currentTime, BEAT/PHRASE/SECTION could move their represented time domain underneath the same finger gesture.
delta: Pointerdown captures one scope window as gesture authority.
All pointermove angle→time mapping uses that frozen window until pointerup/cancel.
The center witness appends HOLD while the frozen window is active.
Pointer release drops the frozen window and resumes ordinary live scope tracking.
